A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of the same work, with matching sections, equations, 12 figures and six tables. Neither contains appendices or the separately cited supplementary material; this comparison covers all material actually supplied.

before.justification: Sections 4.1–4.5 report original degradation-transfer, film-grain, image-restoration and ablation results, including Tables 2–6.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 2–6 and the associated qualitative demonstrations.

M1.justification: The HDEN/IDEN encoders, IDA-SFT synthesis network, loss functions and inversion procedure remain unchanged. The added conditions on the theoretical guarantee do not establish an algorithm or training change.

E1.justification: Both retain WQI-derived synthetic degradations, real-rain transfer, FilmGrainStyle and FFHQ-X restoration tasks. References to supplementary GoPro and ImageNet experiments also remain. Removing the stated number of degradation combinations does not establish changed coverage.

E2.justification: The StyTr2 comparison in Figure 3, restoration comparisons with and without the proposed module in Table 4, and film-grain baseline discussion retain the same comparators. Citation renumbering does not introduce new baselines.

E3.justification: Both report 40K training pairs from about 13K WQI images and 2,000 test triplets from 4,000 held-out images. Metrics, film-grain evaluation, restoration settings and Direct/Global-only/Mixed transfer protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The latent-dimension analysis, entropy-loss ablation and IDA/IDEN ablations are retained with the same evidence in Figure 9 and Tables 5–6. Moving the five-active-dimensions discussion into Section 4.1 does not add an analysis.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The reporting practice remains unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 2–6 match, and the qualitative examples and findings are retained. For example, WQI transfer DISTS remains 0.147 and film-grain transfer DISTS remains 0.053.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 separates the spatial descriptions of degradations from the explicit joint-independence assumption A-5. It also adds that lambda_l and lambda_g must satisfy mild conditions for the separation guarantee. The equations remain unchanged; neither PDF includes the referenced proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about universal degradation modeling, disentanglement by compression, and converting inversion-based restoration to a blind setting.

C2.justification: The disentanglement guarantee is now expressly qualified by conditions on the entropy-loss weights, narrowing its stated applicability. Interpretations of the empirical results and existing dataset and computational limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 drops the explicit count of 16 degradation combinations, while Section 4.5 newly identifies the synthesis scripts as Python. Both still promise future code and data release through the same linked repository.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning remain the same. StyTr2 is renumbered with corrected author formatting, and the super-resolution discussion is condensed without changing its central critique.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized wording corrections and condensation, moves part of the latent-analysis discussion, revises the author affiliations and adds acknowledgements. The overall section hierarchy and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables are retained, with limited relocation and reflow: Figure 5 changes columns, and Figure 8 and Table 2 change positions on page 6. The author block is reformatted and Figure 12's caption is shortened.

improvement.justification: Section 3.3 more clearly distinguishes an independence assumption from spatial definitions and qualifies the separation guarantee, modestly improving theoretical precision. The benefit is limited: the added weight conditions remain unspecified in the supplied text, and removing the 16-combination count slightly reduces reproducibility detail. The method and empirical evidence otherwise remain unchanged.
